add_paragraph.text: In here we are considering characters used for formatting options as special characteres. 1️⃣8️⃣. How to link internal pages
Linkable pages & items

add_paragraph.text: Links are ordinary addresses. A free-standing JSON page lives under `data/pages/` and opens through `pages/page.html?page=folder/name` — in any paragraph, list item, caption, special note or table.

To add a page, create `data/pages/methods.json` with a `title` and a `sections` array, then link `pages/page.html?page=methods`. `@name` points at a section anchor on this page; `@cv` opens the reader.

add_paragraph.text: **This feature is still under development, proceed with caution.**

add_heading.heading_text: Move elements closer — space_before

add_paragraph.text: This paragraph sits directly under the heading — `space_before: "none"` removes its top gap.
This one is one step closer than the default — `space_before: "less"`. `space_subtract: 1` does the same thing.

add_special_note.text: `space_before` takes `none`, `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` or `less`. `space_subtract` takes a number of steps — 1 = one step less than the default 3rem.
